title: AnalysisBatchRequest
$comment: The original request remains fingerprint-bound. An explicit repair may atomically claim failed -> running(repair_count=1) only with unused budget, nonempty wholly repairable diagnostics and no retained stage. Completed, nonrepairable and budget-spent items replay without regeneration. A repair request preserves ordered item/Zotero/note identities; a global aspect finding permits Canvas-summary-only changes, not scientific content or topology rewrites.
